skill.name: linear
skill.description: Manage Linear issues, projects, documentation, and team workflows through the Linear MCP server.
skill.summary: Use Linear MCP workflows to plan, triage, update, and report on team work.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: All static findings were judged false positives after source review. The external command hits are Markdown setup instructions, code fences, or Linear MCP tool names. The network and blocker hits are expected Linear MCP URLs or prose, with no prompt injection or exfiltration intent found.

static_findings.snippet: - Set `[features] rmcp_client = true` in `config.toml` **or** run `codex --enable rmcp_client`
- Leverage context: reference prior issues in new requests.
- Tool Calling Errors: Confirm the model supports multiple tool calls, provide all required fields,
- Break large updates into smaller batches to avoid rate limits; cache or reuse filters when listing

content.value_statement: Teams lose time when project work is scattered across issues, cycles, comments, and documents. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Linear MCP workflows for planning, triage, updates, and reporting.
actual_capabilities: Guide setup of the Linear MCP server with OAuth when it is missing.
Read Linear issues, projects, teams, users, labels, comments, documents, and cycles through MCP tools.
Create or update Linear issues, projects, labels, and comments with required fields.
Support sprint planning, bug triage, documentation audits, release planning, and workload reviews.
Summarize completed actions, open blockers, remaining gaps, and suggested next steps.
limitations: Requires the Linear MCP server and OAuth access before tool calls can work.
Can only access Linear data allowed by the connected user account.
Large bulk updates may need smaller batches because of Linear API rate limits.
Does not replace Linear permissions, workspace policies, or human review for destructive changes.

use_cases.title: Plan a Sprint
use_cases.description: Review open team issues, select high-priority work, and prepare cycle updates with assignments and follow-up actions.

use_cases.title: Triage Bugs
use_cases.description: Find critical and high-priority bugs, compare impact, apply labels, and move selected issues through the workflow.

use_cases.title: Audit Documentation Work
use_cases.description: Search Linear documents, identify outdated areas, and create documentation issues with clear fixes and owners.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Issues
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a personal status check.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my open Linear issues, group them by status, and summarize what needs attention today.

prompt_templates.title: Triage Team Bugs
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for issue filtering and ranking.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review high-priority bugs for the Platform team, rank them by user impact, and suggest labels or status changes.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Sprint Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for planning across issues and cycles.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan the next sprint for the Mobile team using open priority issues, current assignees, estimates, and cycle capacity.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Release Work
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for project and dependency management.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a release plan from existing Linear issues, identify blockers, suggest milestones, and draft follow-up comments for owners.

output_examples.input: Review open issues for the API team and suggest priorities.
output_examples.output: A grouped issue summary by priority and status, with recommended next actions for triage, ownership, and follow-up comments.

output_examples.input: Create documentation tasks for outdated authentication docs.
output_examples.output: A concise list of proposed Linear issues, each with a title, owner suggestion, priority, and clear acceptance criteria.

output_examples.input: Summarize stale work assigned to me this week.
output_examples.output: A personal workload report that highlights stale issues, blocked work, due dates, and suggested status updates.

best_practices: Confirm the team, project, labels, cycle, and due dates before making changes.
Read existing Linear context before creating or updating issues.
Batch related updates and summarize each applied change clearly.
anti_patterns: Do not create or update many issues without confirming the scope first.
Do not assume workspace permissions or team names without checking Linear data.
Do not use vague issue titles when creating work items.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps manage Linear issues, projects, documents, comments, teams, and cycles through MCP-guided workflows.

faq.question: Does it require Linear MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. The Linear MCP server must be connected and authorized before the skill can call Linear tools.

faq.question: Can it create and update issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide issue creation and updates when the required Linear fields and permissions are available.

faq.question: Can it manage bulk changes?
faq.answer: Yes, but the skill recommends batching changes and explaining the grouping before applying them.

faq.question: Will it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it access private Linear data?
faq.answer: It can only access data allowed by the authenticated Linear account and workspace permissions.
